questions.scenario: Peter is waking up his sister for school.
questions.question:
Peter: Wake up, Lily! ___________________
Lily: Oh no! It's eight o'clock. I'm late!
questions.explanation: 從 Lily 的回答『It's eight o'clock (八點鐘)』可判定問句是在詢問時間。
questions.commonMisconception: 沒看見回答中的時間資訊就隨意猜測問句。

questions.scenario: A mother is asking her son to get ready for dinner.
questions.question:
Mother: Jimmy, look at the big clock. ___________________
Jimmy: It's six o'clock. Time for dinner!
questions.explanation: clock (時鐘) 提示要詢問時間。回答中的 six o'clock 驗證正確問法為 What time is it?。
questions.commonMisconception: 基礎 Wh- 問句功能混淆。

questions.scenario: At the bus stop, a man is looking at his watch.
questions.question:
Man: Excuse me. __________________?
Woman: It's ten o'clock.
questions.explanation: 向陌生人詢問時間的標準禮貌句型。回答為時間點。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法正確運用社交場合的時間詢問語句。

questions.scenario: Teachers are talking about the class schedule.
questions.question:
Teacher A: Is it three o'clock?
Teacher B: No, __________________. It's two o'clock.
questions.explanation: 針對單數時間問句 Is it...? 的否定簡答為 No, it isn't.。後文糾正為兩點驗證否定意圖。
questions.commonMisconception: 否定回答與後文資訊的對稱邏輯掌握不佳。

questions.scenario: A child is impatient for his favorite TV show.
questions.question:
Child: Is it five o'clock now?
Mom: Yes, __________________. You can watch TV now.
questions.explanation: Yes 引導肯定簡答，時間主詞為 it。選項 B 語意矛盾。
questions.commonMisconception: Yes 後方搭配否定縮寫 (Yes, it isn't) 的嚴重語誤。

questions.scenario: Phonics: Long vowel i_e sound.
questions.question: Which word has the same vowel sound as 'kite'?
questions.explanation: kite 與 five 均為長母音 /aɪ/ (i_e 結構)。其餘為短音 /ɪ/。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法區別字母 i 的長音 /aɪ/ 與短音 /ɪ/。

questions.scenario: Asking for the exact time in English class.
questions.question:
Teacher: What time is it?
Student: ___________________
questions.explanation: 完整正確的時間表達需包含 Be 動詞 (It's) 以及 o'clock (鐘點)。選項 B 漏了 o'。
questions.commonMisconception: 遺漏 o'clock 中間的撇號與小寫 o。

questions.scenario: Talking about the time on a broken clock.
questions.question:
A: Look at the old clock. Is it four o'clock?
B: __________________. It's twelve o'clock.
questions.explanation: 與事實 (十二點) 不符，應選否定簡答 No, it isn't.。
questions.commonMisconception: 邏輯判斷正確但在英文肯定/否定對應句型中出錯。

questions.scenario: Phonics: Letter 'i' check.
questions.question: Which word has the /aɪ/ sound?
questions.explanation: bike 符合 i_e 長母音結構。其餘為短母音 /ɪ/。
questions.commonMisconception: 沒注意到字尾不發音的 e 對 i 的發音影響。

questions.scenario: Waiting for a movie to start.
questions.question:
A: __________________?
B: It's seven o'clock. Hurry up!
questions.explanation: 由回答整點時間反推問句。選項 C 為是非問句回答不對稱。
questions.commonMisconception: 分不清詢問具體資訊 (What time) 與確認資訊 (Is it) 的差異。

questions.scenario: Identifying time by looking at a picture.
questions.question:
A: Look! The small hand is on three. The big hand is on twelve.
B: Oh, __________________.
questions.explanation: 長針指 12，短針指 3，代表三點整。選項 B 搞混長短針功能。
questions.commonMisconception: 時鐘指針讀取錯誤與英文表達不一致。

questions.scenario: Phonics: Rhyming with 'time'.
questions.question: Which word rhyme with 'time'?
questions.explanation: time 與 lime 均發長母音 /aɪ/。選項 B 為長母音 /i/。
questions.commonMisconception: 分辨不清相似的長母音組合。

questions.scenario: Asking for time in the morning.
questions.question:
A: Good morning! __________________?
B: It's seven o'clock. Time for breakfast.
questions.explanation: 晨間問候後接詢問時間，對應早餐時刻。選項 B 為問候語。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法結合生活起居情境理解對話意圖。

questions.scenario: Phonics: Letter 'i' sounds like 'kite'.
questions.question: Choose the word with same sound as 'nine'.
questions.explanation: nine 與 fine 均發長母音 /aɪ/。
questions.commonMisconception: 辨識不出相同的韻腳設計。

questions.scenario: Correcting a wrong time statement.
questions.question:
A: It's one o'clock.
B: No, __________________. Look! It's two o'clock.
questions.explanation: 針對 A 的錯誤陳述進行否定並修正。選項 C 主詞不符。
questions.commonMisconception: 代名詞轉換錯誤，將時間主詞當作人稱 I。

questions.scenario: Phonics: Long vowel exercise.
questions.question: In 'time' and 'five', the sound of 'i' is ___________.
questions.explanation: 發音術語題。a_i 與 i_e 均為長母音。
questions.commonMisconception: 術語與實際發音聯想斷裂。

questions.scenario: Talking about an evening clock.
questions.question:
A: __________________
B: It's ten o'clock. Go to bed now.
questions.explanation: 由具體時間回答推論問句。選項 C 會得到 Yes/No 回答。
questions.commonMisconception: 句型對應不夠嚴謹。

questions.scenario: Phonics: Rhyming with 'ride'.
questions.question: Which word rhyme with 'ride'?
questions.explanation: ride 與 wide 具有相同長母音韻腳。選項 D 為短母音。
questions.commonMisconception: 聽不出長母音與短母音的結尾差異。

questions.scenario: Asking for the time of a class.
questions.question:
A: __________________?
B: It's eleven o'clock. English class starts!
questions.explanation: 由十一點整反推時間問句。其餘選項語意不通。
questions.commonMisconception: 沒注意到時間單位的答語對應。

questions.scenario: Predicting time: Small hand on 8, Big hand on 12.
questions.question:
A: Look at the clock. Oh, __________________.
B: Let's go to school.
questions.explanation: 指針情境理解題。長針指 12，短針指 8 代表 8 點整。
questions.commonMisconception: 時鐘概念與英文表達連結失敗。

questions.scenario: Recap: What time?
questions.question:
A: What time is it?
B: __________________
questions.explanation: 最標準的時間回答句法。選項 B 漏了 o'。
questions.commonMisconception: 拼寫格式不完全。

questions.scenario: Recap: Is it...?
questions.question:
A: Is it five o'clock?
B: __________________. It's four o'clock.
questions.explanation: 內容錯誤選否定回答。主詞一致。選項 C 人稱錯誤。
questions.commonMisconception: 代名詞選配不一致。

questions.scenario: Phonics: Letter 'i' sounds like 'fish'.
questions.question: Choose the word with the SHORT 'i' sound.
questions.explanation: milk 是短母音 /ɪ/。其餘均為 i_e 長母音。
questions.commonMisconception: 分辨不出短母音發音特色。

questions.scenario: Reading a clock at night.
questions.question:
A: Look at the moon. What time is it?
B: __________________
questions.explanation: 月亮提示夜晚，十一點整合理。下午一點沒月亮。選項 C, D 答非所問。
questions.commonMisconception: 沒注意到與環境背景 (moon) 的合理性配對。

questions.scenario: Recap: What is it? vs What time is it?
questions.question:
A: __________________?
B: It's an old clock.
questions.explanation: 回答是物品名稱 (clock)，應問 What is it?。選項 B 是問裡點鐘。
questions.commonMisconception: 對詢問事物與詢問功能的區別能力薄弱。

questions.scenario: Phonics: Word without 'i' long sound.
questions.question: Which word sounds DIFFERENT?
questions.explanation: sit 是短音。其餘均為 i_e 長音結構。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法在拼寫相似的字群中找出发音相異者。

questions.scenario: Asking for time after P.E. class.
questions.question:
A: P.E. class is over. __________________?
B: It's four o'clock. Time to go home.
questions.explanation: 對話語境指向放學時間。對應回答四點整。
questions.commonMisconception: 沒抓到過場情境提示。

questions.scenario: Phonics: Double check 'nine'.
questions.question: Choose the word with same sound as 'nine'.
questions.explanation: nine 與 line 具有相同韻腳 /aɪn/。
questions.commonMisconception: 不辨字母 e 結尾音變規律。

questions.scenario: Asking for simple time confirmation.
questions.question:
A: Is it one o'clock?
B: Yes, __________________. Hurry up!
questions.explanation: 肯定回答應選 it is。選項 C 複數錯誤。
questions.commonMisconception: 沒看見 Yes 且錯選主詞代名詞。

questions.scenario: Final recap: Clock in a room.
questions.question:
Look! There is a clock under the window. __________________?
It's six o'clock.
questions.explanation: 回答整點時間，必然問詢時間問句。選項 B 是問顏色。
questions.commonMisconception: 沒看見回答中的重點資訊點。
